test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following diseases is borne by mosquitoes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Filariasis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Filariasis is a parasitic disease caused by an infection with roundworms of the Filarioidea type.
 
• It is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.
 
• The most common manifestations are lymphatic filariasis, which can lead to elephantiasis, and subcutaneous filariasis.
 
• In regions where filariasis is common, long-term exposure can cause severe disability and social stigma.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pneumonia**

 
 
• Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs.
 
• It is typically caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
 
• Symptoms include cough, fever, and difficulty breathing.
 
• It is not transmitted by mosquitoes.
 
 
 
• **Goitre**
 
 
• Goitre is an abnormal enlargement of the thyroid gland.
 
• The most common cause is iodine deficiency.
 
• It is not transmitted by mosquitoes.
 
 
 
• **Cholera**
 
 
• Cholera is an acute diarrheal illness caused by infection of the intestine with Vibrio cholerae bacteria.
 
• It is typically contracted from contaminated water or food.
 
• It is not transmitted by mosquitoes.
